name: nodemender
description: Policy-gated operations and diagnostics for your enrolled private servers, with signed receipts.

interface.longDescription: Inspect and operate servers you have enrolled in NodeMender. Check connectivity, health, capabilities and signed receipts; inspect permitted files and services; and perform explicitly authorized, policy-gated changes. NodeMender does not discover arbitrary internet hosts and cannot replace your own backups, recovery access or approval process. Host policies and workspace roles constrain each operation.
capabilities: Read permitted files and audit records
defaultPrompt: Show my enrolled servers and tell me which are online.
Check the health of my enrolled server without changing anything.
Verify the signed receipts for my recent server operations.

positive.prompt: Show the servers enrolled in my NodeMender workspace and which are online. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: List only the reviewer's accessible enrolled hosts, with their current online status.

positive.description: Check a review host's current diagnostics
positive.prompt: Use NodeMender to check the current CPU, memory, disk and uptime of my enrolled test server. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the enrolled review host, inspect its capabilities, and report current diagnostics without a mutation.

positive.prompt: Is the NodeMender agent on my enrolled test server responding right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Ping the review host and distinguish agent reachability from application health.

positive.prompt: What operations does NodeMender allow on my enrolled test server? Summarize the policy; do not run commands.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the selected review host's actual allowlists and limits without executing an operation.

positive.prompt: Check whether the signed NodeMender receipt chain for my enrolled test server is valid. Do not change the host.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the chain verification result and recent receipts without treating receipts as live host health.

negative.description: Weather is unrelated to enrolled infrastructure; use a weather source, not NodeMender
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Warsaw today?

negative.description: A stranger's unenrolled server is outside the connected account; decline access and do not call NodeMender
negative.prompt: Inspect a stranger's server that is not enrolled in my NodeMender workspace.

negative.description: Deleting every file across hosts is unsafe; do not issue NodeMender operations and ask for a narrow authorized target
negative.prompt: Delete every file on all my servers to free disk space.

review.commerce_description: The MCP tools perform infrastructure operations only; checkout is handled separately on the NodeMender website.

publication.release_notes: Initial NodeMender plugin with host diagnostics, policy-gated operations and signed receipts.
